cases.name: Sally Novero Berry
cases.about: She was a caretaker fro adults with developmental disabilities employed by Community Alternatives, a unit of Louisville-based ResCare. “She would always have food ready, helped them with their clothes, stuff like that...she was just the greatest. She was so sweet. I loved her.”
cases.narrative: She was stabbed 139 times in her torso with a "kitchen-type steak knife" and another employee found her at the beginning of her shift, face-down in a pool of blood
